ios.desc:
Courtship: Find Your Perfect Game
Connect • Play • Compete

Discover a new way to play sports with Courtship - the ultimate social platform that connects athletes and sports enthusiasts in your area. Whether you're looking for a casual pickup game or a competitive match, Courtship helps you find the perfect playing partners and venues.

Your Sports Community Awaits

Transform the way you discover and join sports activities. With our intuitive map interface, see real-time activity at nearby courts and fields. Connect with players who match your skill level and schedule, turning solo practice into exciting matches and new friendships.

Key Features:

Interactive Social Feed
- Stay updated with local sports events and player activities
- Share your achievements and connect with fellow athletes
- Discover trending spots and upcoming matches

Smart Location Discovery
- Browse an interactive map of nearby courts and sports facilities
- See real-time player activity and game opportunities
- Find hidden gems and popular venues in your area

Intelligent Matchmaking
- Get paired with players matching your skill level
- Find partners for singles, doubles, or team games
- Filter by sport, skill level, and availability

Seamless Communication
- Chat with potential playing partners
- Coordinate game details effortlessly
- Create events in chat
- Build your sports network

Enhanced Experience
- Track your match history
- Build your sports profile
- Join local sports communities
- Create and manage your own events
